# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We actively maintain security patches for the current version of Roognis. Please ensure you're using the latest version to benefit from the latest security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in Roognis, please follow these guidelines to report it responsibly:

- **Do NOT open a public issue** to report security problems.
- Instead, please contact the [@Roognis/founders](https://github.com/orgs/Roognis/teams/founders) team privately.
- Include as much detail as possible:
  - Steps to reproduce the issue
  - Impact of the vulnerability
  - Affected components or pages
  - Any suggested mitigations or fixes

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and keep you updated on the progress.

## Important Disclaimer

Roognis is an AI-powered educational platform designed to support NGOs and educational institutions.

- We prioritize the security and privacy of student data and educational content.
- Users should exercise caution when integrating with third-party services.
- Always verify the security practices of any external APIs or services used with Roognis.

## Security Best Practices for Users

- Always use HTTPS when accessing the platform
- Keep your authentication credentials secure
- Report any suspicious activity immediately
- Use strong passwords and enable 2FA where available
- Keep your browser and dependencies up to date

## Data Protection

- We follow industry-standard practices for data protection
- Student privacy and COPPA compliance are priorities
- Educational data is handled with appropriate security measures
- Regular security audits are conducted

## Third-Party Dependencies

Roognis uses various open-source dependencies. We:
- Regularly monitor and update dependencies for security patches
- Use automated tools to detect known vulnerabilities
- Follow security best practices in our build and deployment processes

## Contact

For security-related concerns, please reach out to:
- [@Roognis/founders](https://github.com/orgs/Roognis/teams/founders) team
- Use our private communication channels for sensitive reports

Thank you for helping us keep Roognis secure for educators and students worldwide!
